title: SOJ problem package manifest v1
description: Authoritative manifest contract for package/manifest.json (at most 1 MiB). Slurm packages omit docker and require a regular root judge.sbatch. Docker packages include docker and require a regular root judge.sh, run with /bin/sh from a preloaded image; images are never pulled automatically.

image.description: Immutable preloaded image: sha256 plus 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or a nonempty printable-ASCII repository reference followed by @sha256 and the same digest.

memoryMb.description: Container memory limit in MiB, also used as the total memory-and-swap limit.
